  <h5>My research interests are:</h5>
    <ul>
      <li>Stochastic analysis and probability </li>
      <li>Stochastic optimal control </li>
      <li>Lévy processes</li>
      <li>Decomposition of flows</li>
      <li>Rough paths</li>
      <li>Stochastic dynamics in Lie groups, among others.</li>
    </ul>

<p>
I’m always looking to begin new collaborations, whether related to these topics or in a different area. Please [contact](Contact.html) me for more information.
</p>
